A. 在...期间
B. 除了...之外
C. 尽管
D. 对抗

items.question: the efforts of cycling enthusiasts, the proposal to resurface bicycle paths in County Kildare was defeated yesterday.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“Despite”代入题干后为“the efforts of cycling enthusiasts, the proposal to resurface bicycle paths in County Kildare was defeated yesterday. [Despite]”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：C（Despite）。
